last.q: Third-quarter results reflected higher revenue, net interest margin expansion and modest loan growth, alongside a higher provision expense and operating expenses,
last.a: stated T. Michael Price, President and Chief Executive Officer

last.q: The momentum we generated during the second quarter reinforces our confidence in First Commonwealth’s long‑term outlook,
last.a: stated T. Michael Price, President and Chief Executive Officer

last.q: Despite some credit headwinds, we were pleased to see our capital and liquidity strengthen during the quarter, supported by a strong net interest margin, and stable seasonally-adjusted fee income,
last.a: said T. Michael Price, President and Chief Executive Officer

last.q: Our fourth quarter results capped off a strong year for First Commonwealth, highlighted by solid loan and deposit growth, continued expansion of our net interest margin, and stable capital levels,
last.a: said T. Michael Price, President and Chief Executive Officer

last.q: We are pleased to welcome Joe to the First Commonwealth Board of Directors,
last.a: said Jon Gorney, Chairman of the Board of First Commonwealth

last.q: Our third quarter results reflect continued momentum across our core banking operations,
last.a: stated T. Michael Price, President and Chief Executive Officer
